name: Replies
description: A mod that adds replying to comments.

coloured-branches.name: Coloured branches
coloured-branches.description: Whether the reply branches should be coloured based on the depth.

date-display.name: Date Display
date-display.description:
How the date is shown on each cell.
<cy>Relative</c> is the vanilla "2 months ago".
<cy>Exact</c> shows a real calendar date.
<cy>Exact + relative</c> shows both.

Replies posted through the mod always carry an exact timestamp. The root comment only has one if <cg>RobTop's server</c> sent it; when it didn't, the relative string is used instead.

date-include-time.name: Include Time of Day
date-include-time.description: Adds the hour and minute to exact dates (<cy>2026-09-19 14:32</c> instead of <cy>2026-09-19</c>). Has no effect while <cl>Date Display</c> is set to <cy>Relative</c>.

show-reply-ids.name: Show Reply IDs
show-reply-ids.description: Shows the ID of each reply next to its date. Long IDs are shortened on the cell — the full value is in the info popup.

info-popup.name: Clickable Date
info-popup.description: Makes the date line on each cell open a <cl>Reply Info</c> popup with the full ID, both local and UTC timestamps, the author's account ID and a copy button.
